payload.title: Calibrate H1 observer/probe effect on Ubuntu
payload.work_clay: From common frozen H1 snapshots, compare no-probe, disabled, armed/no-emit, sampling, symmetric-inline and asymmetric-path observation modes; measure paired event-order, semantic-outcome and emergence-readout divergence plus cost.
payload.reason_clay: Causal-emergence measurement is invalid if observation itself changes timing/order near competition or re-entry boundaries; synthetic proof and systems literature establish this confound class.
payload.completion_clay: Executed Ubuntu H1 receipt with preregistered tolerances, paired common-snapshot comparison, trace completeness/drop accounting, timing-slack stratification and explicit PASS/FAIL/NO_CHANGE observer-effect classification.
payload.executor_policy: Research Entity execution organ only; Frank has no Harness self-modification authority.
invalidators: A newer executed H1 calibration already resolves probe noninterference for all planned backends/modes.
